The grey baseline is the club's recorded season vector, games-weighted over every lineup it fielded. A roster identical to its starters can therefore sit slightly away from it.

Similarity to every club of the season (cosine)

Cosine saturates near 1 for every pair because 95% of a club vector's length is a component shared by all clubs, so read the ORDER, not the absolute value. The ranking is informative: across all club pairs its Spearman correlation with style-space distance is −0.91.
